title: Maharashtra Shops and Establishments private-beta review decision
authorityBoundary: The deterministic rule executes before retrieval and provider output.
Complete and reported-gap inputs remain specialist-review.

Retrieval and provider output cannot infer location, establishment type or employee count; choose a threshold; treat a draft as final; validate a filing or certificate; or determine a duty, breach, penalty or enforcement consequence.
privacyBoundary: No names, addresses, contact details, registration numbers, employee identities, age or gender data, schedules, attendance, wages, payroll, applications, certificates, notices, orders, disputes or evidence bodies.
Only controlled State-scope, source-readiness, draft-reconciliation, classification-control, worker-count-control, version, escalation statuses and evidence references may be processed.
sourceBoundary: All five Maharashtra records are source-identity snapshots rather than full controlled-file fingerprints.
The November 2025 amendment record remains draft and cannot supply an operative threshold, form or working-condition rule.
No State or Union Territory other than Maharashtra is represented as onboarded.

approval.notes: Software implementation and tests do not constitute Maharashtra legal, privacy, RAG, security or release approval.
